name: au.com.suburbscanner/suburbscanner
title: SuburbScanner
description: Australian suburb context from open government data, national asking-price figures, holding costs.

tools.name: find_suburb
tools.description: Look up a published Australian suburb by name or postcode and get its SuburbScanner id and page. Use the id with get_suburb_local_context and search_major_projects. Returns up to 10 matches.

query.description: A suburb name or a 4-digit postcode, for example "Wollongong" or "2500".

state.description: Optional: limit to one state or territory.

tools.name: get_suburb_local_context
tools.description: Open government data for one published suburb: major projects that government registers list within 10 km (status, cost, timing, register link), new dwellings approved and estimated population for the ABS statistical area (SA2) it sits in, and its SA2, SA3 and SA4. Does not include prices, rents or yields.

suburb_id.description: The suburb id from find_suburb, for example "wollongong-nsw".

tools.name: search_major_projects
tools.description: Search the major infrastructure, resources and energy projects that Australian government registers list as planned or under way. Filter by state, kind, minimum published cost, or distance from a published suburb. Status, cost and timing are each register's own; every row links to its register.

kind.description: Optional kind, for example Road, Rail, Health, Energy, Water, Gold, Copper.

near_suburb_id.description: Optional: only projects with a published location near this suburb (id from find_suburb).

min_cost_aud.description: Optional: only projects with a published cost at or above this, in dollars.

limit.description: How many to return, largest published cost first. Default 10.

tools.name: get_market_breadth
tools.description: National and state statistics on Australian residential asking prices over the latest three months: the share of reliably measured suburb markets with a lower median asking price, the median change, and the same for gross yields, houses and units separately. SuburbScanner's own aggregates; quote them with both credit lines given. No suburb-level figures.

tools.name: calculate_holding_cost
tools.description: Pre-tax weekly cost or surplus of holding an Australian investment property at a given price and weekly rent, on the user's own loan and cost assumptions, plus the break-even rent and break-even interest rate. Arithmetic only: it uses no market data and is not advice.

weekly_rent.description: Expected rent in dollars a week.

deposit_pct.description: Deposit as a percentage of the price. Default 20.

interest_rate_pct.description: Interest rate, % a year. Default 6.41% (Reserve Bank of Australia, Table F6: new investor housing loans funded in the month, variable rate, all institutions, 2026-09).

vacant_weeks_per_year.description: Weeks a year with no rent (an assumption, not a vacancy rate). Default 2.

tools.name: price_change_as_rate_change
tools.description: Restate a change in a property's price as the interest-rate change that would move the loan repayment by the same amount (for example, how many rate rises a 10% lower price offsets). Arithmetic on the user's own numbers; not a forecast or advice.

price_change_pct.description: The price change in percent. Negative is a lower price, for example -10.

price.description: Optional price before the change, in dollars, to also get the monthly repayment difference.

deposit_pct.description: Deposit as a percentage of the price. Default 20.

interest_rate_pct.description: Interest rate, % a year. Default 6.41% (Reserve Bank of Australia, Table F6: new investor housing loans funded in the month, variable rate, all institutions, 2026-09).

tools.name: about_suburbscanner_data
tools.description: What the SuburbScanner connector covers, where each piece comes from, its licence and how to credit it, and what it does not include. Use before quoting figures.
